title: Alien Queen and Wanderer
description: A surreal painting depicts a large cracked portrait of a grey alien wearing a golden crown, set within a vibrant circular mandala frame. In the foreground, a lone traveler with deer antlers, a patterned cloak, and a backpack walks along a broken red path, surrounded by floating cat-like masks, flowers, and a large butterfly.
prompt: A surreal psychedelic painting featuring a large cracked portrait of a grey alien queen with a golden crown and large black eyes, centered inside a vibrant orange and teal circular mandala. In the foreground, a lone traveler wearing a blue patterned cloak, deer antlers, and a backpack walks along a broken red path. Floating around are white cat masks, large orange chrysanthemums, a yellow butterfly, and a small skull, with swirling colorful skies and dark mountains in the background.
